fields.why: Tables 1-2 report 'Absolute change in mean weekly ED visit counts' with the percent change in parentheses, alongside VRs; an absolute difference is computed and reported, so scale is both, not relative only.

The Discussion offers return to school/community environments, fewer adverse childhood experiences and federal investments (988 line, telehealth access) as explanations of the trend, which fits 'offered as an explanation of an outcome'; but they carry no equity framing and resemble the excluded pandemic service-disruption case, so null is also defensible.

brief_issues: Determinants rule: unclear whether pandemic-recovery explanations (school reopening, ACEs, federal access investments) with no equity framing count; the exclusion covers disruptions but not their reversal.
